scope: Read-only local source investigation; zero network calls, tests, inference, product/config changes or deployment

agentApi.reason: Both orchestration calls set modelTier smart; ChatWithAgentDto accepts only message, conversationId and context. resolvedModel after execution labels metrics/metadata, not the provider call. executionBudgetMs is consumed by RUN_AGENT workflow, not this controller.

request.prompt: JSON.stringify({briefing, currentConcept?, refinement?, schema, allowedCatalog}); omit contact/name/phone/email/history not needed for composition
request.systemPrompt: Existing exclusive concept generator instructions, maximum10000 characters

supportedFastToolFreeCandidate.response: {data:{text,model,usage}}; parse data.text then existing schema/invariant validation; never execute generated content
supportedFastToolFreeCandidate.tools: No tools field/dispatch in CompletionService.generate/provider.complete body; plain text generation only
supportedFastToolFreeCandidate.authentication: Server-only BB organization-scoped API key in X-API-Key or Authorization: ApiKey; exact allowed resource POST /ai-engine/api/v1/ai/generate. Alternatively BB IAM access JWT with organizationId and AI_ENGINE_EXECUTE. Panel site API token is not proven compatible. Never send key to browser.
supportedFastToolFreeCandidate.credentialBoundary: BB uses its own server-configured Anthropic provider. It does not accept the panel owner credentialId/provider key. Ownership/billing/configuration must be verified before adoption; not drop-in equivalent to existing owner agent credential.
supportedFastToolFreeCandidate.budget: No request-supported wall-clock execution budget. Current BB ClaudeProvider uses120000ms per attempt and up to3 retries; client timeout does not prove upstream cancellation or latency. Must smoke actual deployment before choosing.

AI_GENERATE_TEXT.caveat: Uses global LLMProviderFactory.getProviderByName/getProvider, no tenant credentialId; workflow payload/action logs persist data. Not the existing owner agent credential.

defects: Handler posts /api/v1/generate, but actual BB path is /ai-engine/api/v1/ai/generate
Handler reads response.body.text; BB response wraps content in data.text
Handler does not forward provider/language although direct BB schema supports them
No credentialId falls back to platform token; no per-tenant identity override on this handler

workflowAlternatives.aiChat: Rejected: /ai/chat is full platform assistant and explicitly can execute tools; not a tool-free concept generator.

conclusion: No supported public request switches the current dedicated agent chat to fast while preserving its owner credential. The direct BB API is a supported fast tool-free text endpoint at source level, but auth/provider billing and actual latency remain unverified. Do not change agent/global settings or adopt a workflow workaround without those checks.

ownerCredentialHttpBridgeAudit.scope: Additional read-only local source inspection; no network or code/configuration changes
ownerCredentialHttpBridgeAudit.reason: CredentialResolverService.resolveHeaders switch has only JWT_BEARER, OAUTH2_CLIENT_CREDENTIALS, OAUTH2_AUTHORIZATION_CODE, BASIC_AUTH, API_KEY and CUSTOM_HEADERS. AI_PROVIDER falls through to an empty headers object. WEB_REQUEST never maps AI_PROVIDER.apiKey to x-api-key.
ownerCredentialHttpBridgeAudit.apiKeyCredentialAlternative: API_KEY can bind encrypted key to header paramName=x-api-key/location=header, but requires another explicit credential containing a known key. Existing masked AI_PROVIDER cannot be aliased or safely converted through this API; no extraction attempted.
ownerCredentialHttpBridgeAudit.otherActions: BaseAIHandler/AI handlers expose no credentialId. No registered HTTP_REQUEST or LLM_TEXT_GENERATE alternate. Agent chat/test public DTO still offers no direct provider or fast override.
ownerCredentialHttpBridgeAudit.recommendation: Do not construct a workflow bridge with this credential or expose/extract its key. Continue the existing owned-agent path with a durable job/deadline appropriate to observed real latency, or use a separately authorized supported provider integration.
